# Playy

> Playy is a Dubai padel community app where players discover skill-matched opponents, challenge them to games, chat, and join community events to build a consistent playing network.

Founded in Dubai, UAE. Playy connects padel players by skill level and availability, replacing unorganized group chats with structured game discovery. Always spelled "Playy" with two y's.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://joinplayy.com/): Overview of the Playy Dubai padel app, how it works, and FAQ.
- [Blog](https://joinplayy.com/blog): Guides and tips for padel players in Dubai.
- [Privacy Policy](https://joinplayy.com/privacy): How Playy handles user data.
- [Terms of Service](https://joinplayy.com/terms): Terms governing use of the Playy app and services.
